meaning.en: An advanced music class taught by an eminent musician.

meaning.en: A class taught by an accomplished musician who individually instructs advanced students in performance and technique, often before an audience.

meaning.en: A class, typically in a performing art such as music or drama, in which a teacher listens to and critiques the performance of individual students, one at a time, while the other students look on.
